headline: Manavta Holdings files substantial acquisition disclosure for Chambal Fertilizers under SEBI takeover code
sum: Manavta Holdings Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011 for a substantial acquisition in Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited, signaling a material shareholding event requiring public disclosure.
detail: Manavta Holdings Limited has submitted a formal disclosure to the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation requires disclosure when a person or group acquires shares in a target company in prescribed tranches or circumstances. The filing was received by the exchange on 16 June 2026. The specific shareholding acquired, consideration, and whether an open offer will follow have not been disclosed in this preliminary disclosure document.
